title: Scute Companions!
description: Changes the texture of the Wolf Armor to look like it is made of Turtle Scutes!
body:
**Scute Companions gives a new, more turtly look to the Wolf Armor!**

---
Changes the looks of the Wolf Armor to make it look like it was made of Turtle Scutes. The pack can also be used as a datapack to change the recipe of the armor accordingly, making the boring Armadillos even more useless!
